attempts.summary: Built an Ansible playbook on node1 that creates a "Fleet Internal CA" (self-signed openssl CA), issues a TLS certificate for node2 (CN=node2, SAN DNS:node2/IP:10.100.196.11), deploys nginx on node2 to serve HTTPS on port 8443 with that certificate, and installs the CA into the system trust store on both node1 and node2. Verified end-to-end with an openssl chain verify and a curl request to https://node2:8443 that validated successfully against the system CA trust store. Also fixed a pre-existing broken sshd on node2 (missing host keys, missing /run/sshd, service disabled) so Ansible could reach it over SSH. Completed the mandatory sequential restart-and-recovery protocol on all three nodes with boot-id proof of restart and post-restart health verification.
